label: Hard mode: every archetype, with only 5% of the endpoints open
description: A mix of all archetypes, per block of 20 endpoints: the documented policies, usage budgets, identified access, zero tolerance, a tarpit, empty answers under pressure and a shared budget. Suites with fewer than 20 endpoints get the most common archetypes; use the archetype-<id> profiles to test each archetype alone.
